_README: Job titles to search for, in groups. Copy this to config/search_terms.json
and edit it, or let the setup conversation fill it in for you.
This file is read fresh on every search pass, never copied into the code, so
adding a term here changes the next search with no restart and no release.
Every term in 'core' and 'non_core' is run as a search on every source that
takes a query — on its own, and again with each entry-level wording added.
A term listed here is IN FOCUS: no title rule may quietly drop it. Whether a
posting is too senior is decided by reading the whole description and quoting
it, never by the title alone.
core      = applied to first, newest first.
non_core  = applied to once there is nothing in core left. It is allowed to
wait indefinitely; that is the point.
exclude   = never applied to, whatever else matches.
levels    = wording added to each term to find entry-level versions of it.
seniority = title words that rule a posting out on their own. Other seniority
language is context, and needs a quoted sentence.
